name: advancement always recomputes competition ranks from wins
sql: rank() over (order by wins desc) as place; where ranked.place <> caller.rank

name: equal-rank allocation uses car number before stable source ID
organiser can fabricate advancement lineage through direct car insert
sql: grant insert on public.cars to authenticated;

name: admin can escalate privileges by issuing an owner invitation
sql: if not has_org_role(org, array['owner','admin']) then raise exception; end if; insert invitation role_name;

name: invitation cannot be revoked through an authenticated audited command
team identity requires broad direct auth users access
sql: grant select on auth.users to authenticated;

name: organisation access tables are absent from authorised realtime
sql: alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.heats;
